scope: Primary README/card and file-inventory inspection; not code execution, full-paper review or reproduced experiments.

exclusions.reason: Already proposed in awesomejev-next-github.jsonl; count only once across batches. The robustness record is more specific and may replace the simpler GitHub proposal without increasing the source count.

clarifications.finding: Both candidate sets place the correct answer first. Unshuffled evaluation leaks answer position.
clarifications.suggested_relevance: Visual-choice benchmark with source-derived labels and model-written distractors, not fully human-verified; both option lists place the gold answer first and require shuffling with label remapping.
clarifications.suggested_additional_limitation: Randomize and remap option order before evaluation; both stored candidate lists begin with the gold answer. Labels and evidence boxes are not fully human-verified.

clarifications.finding: Published numbers and screenshots concern a deterministic lexical mock, not Jev; synthetic labels await sampled human review.
clarifications.action: Retain as an evaluation tool, not empirical model-performance evidence. Existing relevance and limitations correctly disclose this.

clarifications.finding: Fixtures and policy share an author; neutral independently labeled tickets are unfinished.
clarifications.action: Retain as a policy harness, not independently validated customer-routing evidence.

clarifications.finding: Human review coverage differs between core and extension.
clarifications.action: Keep single-annotator core and LLM-assisted, partially checked extension separate in any comparison.
clarifications.suggested_relevance: Decision-encoder robustness tests on a single-annotator core and a partly checked, LLM-assisted extension; examines option order, label naming and equivalent binary questions.

clarifications.finding: Adds blank/shuffled-media and option controls over reused public robot sources; this is an original evaluation artifact, not a newly human-labeled corpus.
clarifications.action: Preserve human-versus-construction label distinction, text-shortcut caveat and evaluation-only terms. Construction validity is author-described, not independently established here.

clarifications.finding: Bengali study reuses expert source labels; paired English questions are controls.
clarifications.action: Describe the new resource as an experimental evaluation, not an independently annotated English translation dataset.

clarifications.finding: Source title phrases negative outcomes broadly, while the evidence is a small handwritten zero-shot diagnostic.
clarifications.action: Keep the existing small-sample limitation visible; avoid interpreting the headline as a universal statement about Laya.

clarifications.finding: Contains a reranking run archive using existing source relevance labels.
clarifications.action: Keep result-archive wording; do not relabel it as new training data or fresh independent annotation.

clarifications.finding: Contains predictions joined to existing Traditional-Chinese benchmark questions.
clarifications.action: Keep result-archive wording and requirement to reproduce joins against upstream item identities.

limits: All14 candidate descriptions, label provenance and evaluation limitations were inspected; five highest-risk primary cards were refetched, with all five hashes matching.
Remaining source checks rely on the collector evidence and its inspected primary excerpts; no fresh full-batch scan was performed.
No dataset rows, model executions, benchmark results or licenses were independently reproduced or exhaustively audited.
All evidence grades remain content_screened; acceptance is source relevance/provenance review, not scientific endorsement.
13 unique additions are recommended after deduplication with the pending33-project GitHub batch; the duplicate source may be represented by the richer robustness record instead.
